newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia says '96 inflation rate cut to 3.7 percent.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia says '96 inflation rate cut to 3.7 percent.

text.p: Tunisia's 1996 inflation as measured by the consumer price index (CPI) fell to 3.7 percent from 6.3 percent in 1995, the National Institute of Statistics said on Tuesday.
CPI rose by 0.1 percent in December compared to November.
The drop in the inflation rate for 1996 was made possible by decreases in prices of foodstuffs, thanks to rainfalls that led to higher agriculture output after a two-year drought.
Details of price increases in 1996 compared to 1995:
Leisure and miscellaneous: 5.2 percent from 6.0 percent.
